lessonTitle: 33. The surface area of a cylinder
lessonTitleEnglish: The surface area of a cylinder
unit: Geometry · Chapter I. Solids of revolution
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: The lateral surface of a cylinder unrolls into a rectangle 2πr by h, so S(lateral) = 2πrh.
stages.headlineEnglish: The lateral surface of a cylinder unrolls into a rectangle 2πr by h, so S(lateral) = 2πrh.

stages.headline: The total surface area is S = 2πrh + 2πr² = 2πr(h + r).
stages.headlineEnglish: The total surface area is S = 2πrh + 2πr² = 2πr(h + r).

stages.headline: Example: r = 3, h = 5: S(lateral) = 30π and S(total) = 30π + 18π = 48π.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: r = 3, h = 5: S(lateral) = 30π and S(total) = 30π + 18π = 48π.
